Name: (CP) Stardew Kids Expansion - Juna Roommate NPC Location Fix
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][u][b]What is it?[/b][/u]
I have a little bit of a perfectionist streak in me, and when I see NPCs overlapping I [b]HAVE[/b] to fix them if the mod author is too busy, etc.

This mod specifically changes the position of Douglas from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expansion[/url] to no longer intersect with the tree added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna Roommate NPC[/url] below the Wizard's tower.﻿﻿

﻿[b][u]Installation
[/u][/b]Unzip the .rar file and drag its contents into your mods folder. Thats it!

[b][u]Have a request?
[/u][/b]If you find any schedule overlaps or festival overlaps in any NPC mods, please let me know!
If the creator of the mods has no intention of fixing the issue (most have bigger things to work on!) and I obtain permission, I'll do my best do push out a patch.[/center]
